dumbbell-shoulder-press.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Neutral Grip

detail.noHistoryHint: Log this exercise in a workout and your sets show up here.

flatPress.title: Set up
flatPress.text: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and plant your feet.

flatPress.title: Lower
flatPress.text: Unrack and lower the bar under control to your lower chest, elbows about 45° from your torso.

flatPress.title: Press
flatPress.text: Drive the bar up and slightly back until your arms are almost straight. Keep your glutes on the bench.

inclinePress.title: Set the bench
inclinePress.text: Set the backrest to 30–45°. Sit down with the dumbbells resting on your thighs.

inclinePress.title: Start position
inclinePress.text: Lie back and press the dumbbells over your chest. Shoulder blades back and down, feet firmly on the floor.

inclinePress.title: Lower
inclinePress.text: Lower the dumbbells slowly to chest height. Your elbows point about 45° away from your torso.

inclinePress.title: Press
inclinePress.text: Press the dumbbells up powerfully until your arms are almost straight. Pause briefly at the top.

overheadPress.title: Brace
overheadPress.text: Hold the weights at shoulder height, wrists stacked over your elbows. Tighten your core and glutes.

overheadPress.title: Press
overheadPress.text: Press straight up until your arms are locked out overhead, moving your head slightly back.

overheadPress.title: Lower
overheadPress.text: Bring the weights back to shoulder height under control without arching your lower back.

raise.title: Start
raise.text: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your sides and a slight bend in your elbows.

raise.title: Raise
raise.text: Lift the weights to shoulder height, leading with your elbows. Don't swing or shrug.

raise.title: Lower
raise.text: Lower slowly over two to three seconds and keep the tension at the bottom.

rearDelt.title: Set up
rearDelt.text: Hinge forward or face the cable with a neutral spine and a slight bend in your elbows.

rearDelt.title: Pull apart
rearDelt.text: Pull your hands out and back until they line up with your shoulders. Squeeze your upper back.

rearDelt.title: Return
rearDelt.text: Let the weight return slowly without losing your posture.

uprightRow.title: Grip
uprightRow.text: Hold the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart, arms hanging long.

uprightRow.title: Pull
uprightRow.text: Lead with your elbows and pull the bar up to lower-chest height. Your elbows stay above your hands.

uprightRow.title: Lower
uprightRow.text: Lower the bar under control. Stop earlier if your shoulders feel pinched.

fly.title: Set up
fly.text: Set the pulleys high, take a handle in each hand and step forward into a split stance.

fly.title: Bring together
fly.text: With softly bent elbows, sweep your hands down and together in front of your chest.

fly.title: Open
fly.text: Let your arms open slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

dip.title: Support
dip.text: Press yourself up on the bars with straight arms, shoulders down and away from your ears.

dip.title: Lower
dip.text: Lean slightly forward and lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.

dip.title: Push
dip.text: Push back up to full extension without swinging your legs.

pushUp.title: Plank
pushUp.text: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.

pushUp.title: Lower
pushUp.text: Lower your chest towards the floor, elbows about 45° from your torso.

pushUp.title: Push
pushUp.text: Push the floor away until your arms are straight. Don't let your hips sag.

tricepsExtension.title: Lock your elbows
tricepsExtension.text: Keep your elbows tucked and your upper arms still for the whole set.

tricepsExtension.title: Extend
tricepsExtension.text: Straighten your arms fully and squeeze your triceps at the end.

tricepsExtension.title: Return
tricepsExtension.text: Bend your elbows slowly back to the start, keeping the tension.

verticalPull.title: Grip
verticalPull.text: Take the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and hang with straight arms.

verticalPull.title: Pull
verticalPull.text: Drive your elbows down towards your hips until your chin clears the bar or the bar reaches your upper chest.

verticalPull.title: Lower
verticalPull.text: Return slowly to straight arms without dropping into the bottom.

row.title: Set up
row.text: Sit or hinge with a long, neutral spine. Arms reach forward, shoulders relaxed.

row.title: Pull
row.text: Row the handle towards your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together.

row.title: Release
row.text: Let your arms stretch forward under control without rounding your back.

deadlift.title: Set up
deadlift.text: Feet hip-width under the bar, shins close. Grip just outside your legs.

deadlift.title: Brace
deadlift.text: Hips down, chest up, back flat. Take a deep breath and pull the slack out of the bar.

deadlift.title: Lift
deadlift.text: Push the floor away and stand up tall, keeping the bar close. Lower it the same way.

curl.title: Start
curl.text: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your sides, elbows close to your body.

curl.title: Curl
curl.text: Bend your elbows and lift the weights towards your shoulders without swinging.

curl.title: Lower
curl.text: Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

squat.title: Stance
squat.text: Feet about shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. Brace your core.

squat.title: Descend
squat.text: Sit down between your hips, knees tracking over your toes, chest up.

squat.title: Drive
squat.text: Push through your whole foot back to standing once your thighs reach parallel or lower.

legPress.title: Feet
legPress.text: Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform, lower back against the pad.

legPress.title: Lower
legPress.text: Release the safety and bend your knees to about 90°.

legPress.title: Press
legPress.text: Push the platform away through your whole foot without locking your knees.

hinge.title: Start
hinge.text: Stand tall with the bar at your hips and your knees slightly bent.

hinge.title: Hinge
hinge.text: Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.

hinge.title: Return
hinge.text: Drive your hips forward to stand up. Your back stays flat throughout.

lunge.title: Stand
lunge.text: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your sides.

lunge.title: Step
lunge.text: Take a long step forward and lower your back knee towards the floor.

lunge.title: Return
lunge.text: Push off your front foot back to the start and switch legs.

legExtension.title: Set up
legExtension.text: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot and place the pad just above your ankles.

legExtension.title: Extend
legExtension.text: Straighten your legs fully and squeeze your quads at the top.

legExtension.title: Lower
legExtension.text: Lower the weight slowly without letting it rest.

calfRaise.title: Position
calfRaise.text: Balls of your feet on the edge, heels free, legs straight.

calfRaise.title: Rise
calfRaise.text: Push up onto your toes as high as you can and pause briefly.

calfRaise.title: Lower
calfRaise.text: Lower your heels slowly below the platform for a full stretch.

plank.title: Forearms
plank.text: Elbows under your shoulders, forearms on the floor.

plank.title: Brace
plank.text: Lift your body into one straight line. Squeeze your glutes and abs.

plank.title: Hold
plank.text: Keep breathing steadily and hold the position without letting your hips sag.
